name: mobile-agent-desktop
description: Windows desktop shell for Mobile Agent.
author: Mobile Agent
_comment: This file is the `electron-builder` manifest. The app is a single pnpm package:
`pnpm-workspace.yaml` lists only ".", so this directory is not a workspace member and
pnpm never installs its dependencies. Electron and electron-builder therefore live in the
repository's root `package.json`, which is why `electronVersion` is pinned explicitly below
instead of being left to node_modules auto-detection -- detection walks `desktop/node_modules`
first and finds nothing there. It must match the root `devDependencies.electron`.
